transliteration: bhrāmad-vīrīta-raṅgāḍhye hy-anakha-sparśa-gocare / parīkṣed ārdra-parṇena caru-kāraṃ sa-ghoṣakam //
sph_interpretive_translation: In circumstances where action arises amidst confusion and turbulence, yet remains imperceptible to direct sensory observation, one must examine it through the lens of awakened discernment—like using a moist leaf to test the resonance of a musical instrument.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates in conscious discernment, not sensory perception
Causation is determined by vibrational alignment, not physical traceability
Capacity-based responsibility is assessed through inner integrity, not external visibility
Restoration logic operates via resonance calibration, not punitive correction
Consciousness alignment supersedes empirical evidence in determining dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent.demonstrates(inner_integrity) THEN capacity.responsibility = TRUE ELSE capacity.responsibility = FALSE
IF dharma.alignment.score > threshold THEN restore.integrity ELSE initiate.awakening_process
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, when actions occur within complex or obscured contexts that defy conventional evidentiary standards, adjudication shall rely upon the principle of resonant discernment. The threshold of responsibility is based on the agent's demonstrated capacity for inner alignment rather than overt behavioral metrics. Authority lies with those capable of perceiving beyond sensory limitations.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa here extends beyond pratyakṣa (direct perception) into anumāna and āptopadeśa (scriptural testimony). Causality unfolds through anupūrvaśaḥ—sequential resonance patterns—not linear fault attribution. Responsibility aligns proportionally with one’s vibrational clarity. There is no punishment; only recalibration toward dharmic frequency.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate resonance-testing protocol using awakened witness validation
Deploy consciousness-alignment workshops to recalibrate distorted frequencies
Assign completion process involving reflective practice until clarity is restored
Reintegrate individual into community through shared vibrational practices
Verify restoration through repeatable discernment trials under similar conditions
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This ruling restores reality as non-punitive, consciousness as the ultimate adjudicator, and dharma as eternally self-correcting.
